content.short: Crypto for Charity enables donations in 100+ cryptocurrencies and NFTs to support charities.
content.description: Crypto for Charity is a zero-fee platform that makes it easy to donate a wide range of crypto assets to causes you care about. It supports 100+ cryptocurrencies and NFTs, allowing donors to give directly to charities without the usual friction of wallets or exchange accounts. Many nonprofits aren’t set up to accept crypto and don’t want the burden of managing wallets or conversions. With Crypto for Charity, nonprofits don’t need to sign up, and the platform handles the conversion to cash for them, at no cost.
